name: market-regime-classifier
description: ML-powered market regime classification — trending, ranging, volatile, quiet. Automatically adapts strategy selection based on detected regime. Use this skill whenever the user asks "is the market trending", "what regime are we in", "ranging or trending", "market conditions", "volatility regime", "classify market state", "adapt strategy", "regime change", "market phase", "consolidation or breakout", "trending market detection", or any question about current market conditions and which strategy type to use. Works with trading-brain for strategy selection and mt5-chart-browser for data.
